name: Cubit
author: Erin Carter
description: A field of isometric cubes rising and falling like a block cityscape — each cube three shaded faces meeting at crisp seams, taller blocks catching more light. Confident hard-edged 3D geometry from flat shapes.

params.label: Cube count
params.effect: How many cubes span the frame; low is big bold blocks, high a dense field.

params.label: Height
params.effect: How much the cubes brighten as they rise; 0 holds them an even height.

params.label: Speed
params.effect: How fast cubes rise and fall; 0 freezes the cityscape.

params.label: Face contrast
params.effect: Shading difference between the three cube faces; high reads boldly three-dimensional.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer raises nearby cubes; 0 ignores the mouse.
